info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Technology Standards Management API
info.description: The Technology Standards Management API enables organizations to update and manage their technology standards effectively. Through this endpoint, users can modify existing standards to ensure they meet evolving business requirements and compliance needs. This API is particularly valuable for IT management teams and technology governance stakeholders who require an efficient way to keep their standards up-to-date. Seamlessly integrate this API into your workflows to enhance organizational agility and maintain best practices in technology deployment.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update specific details of the technology standard identified by RES-100045. Providing the necessary fields in the request body will modify the existing state of the resource.
